name: PULSE VACUUM VERTICAL AUTOCLAVE
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-V-PVAU-220 Pulse Vacuum Vertical Autoclave is a highly advanced, fully automatic steam sterilizer designed to deliver exceptional sterilization performance. This system utilizes a sophisticated imported water-ring vacuum pump to execute pre-vacuum cycles for immediate and efficient air removal, ensuring deep steam penetration.
features: Imported Water Ring Vacuum Pump for Pre and Post Pulse Vacuum Cycles
LCD Smart Controller with 4 Preselected Programs (Glassware, Instrument, Liquid, Dressing)
Internal Steam Collector Tank ensuring zero open steam discharge
Stainless Steel 304 chamber secured by a Hand Wheel Type locking mechanism
0.2µ Bacterial Air Filter for secure chamber ventilation

specifications.Vacuum System: Pre and Post Pulse Vacuum Cycles
specifications.Vacuum Pump: Imported Water Ring Vacuum Pump Included
specifications.Steam Discharge: Internal Steam Collector Tank (No Open Steam Discharge)
